name: @lanework/contracts
description: The contract between the Lanework desktop app, its checkpoint hook, the Lanework API and their MCP servers: HTTP request and response shapes, the board, kit and control tool contracts (types, JSON Schema builders and run-time output shapes).
author: fuongz <hi@phuongphung.com>
//: Types, JSON Schema builders and output shapes only, no runtime dependencies. The desktop app (open source) and the API and MCP (private) both build on it; neither half may be imported here.
